title: Rule-version vector incorrectly assigns reserved IDs 0x7A and 0x7B to fragmentation
description: test/vectors/rule_versioning.json says fragmentation uses rules 120-123. The Version 3 registry and both implementations define only directional fragmentation Rules 0x78/0x79 (120/121); 0x7A-0xFE are reserved. This text could make a consumer accept reserved IDs when versions match. Restrict the vector description/provenance to 0x78 and 0x79.
